title: Lower ME: Back Squat
warmup: Foam roll 2 min, then 2 rounds: Tri-Planar Ankle × 8/side · Inchworm Walk × 4 · CL Dead Bug × 6/side · A-skip 2 × 20 yd · B-skip 2 × 20 yd
jumps: Back Squat 3 · 5-sec lower @ RPE 8 → Hurdle Hops 5 → Trap Bar Jump 5 → Pogo Hops 10
Eccentric wk 2: heavier, 5 sec down · 10–20 sec between steps, 3:00 between rounds · no hurdles? Tuck jumps
strength: Slow, hold a rack or wall
note: Eccentric wk 2: heavier than last week, 5-second lowering.
